title.zh: Liquid Network pauses after purported ‘white-hat’ hackers withdraw $320 million in bitcoin
title.en: Liquid Network pauses after purported ‘white-hat’ hackers withdraw $320 million in bitcoin

current_state.zh: Liquid 网络在自称白帽黑客提取约 3,998 BTC 至单一地址后仍处于暂停状态，联邦钱包储备接近归零，或需等待资金归还才能恢复脱钩提现。
current_state.en: Liquid Network remains paused after self-identified white-hat hackers withdrew ~3,998 BTC to a single address, leaving the federation wallet's reserves near zero and potentially preventing peg-outs until funds are returned.

title.zh: Private German rocket makes history, reaches orbit from European soil
title.en: Private German rocket makes history, reaches orbit from European soil

current_state.zh: 德国初创公司Isar Aerospace在第二次飞行中成功进入轨道并部署有效载荷，标志着欧洲私人航天史上的首次。
current_state.en: German startup Isar Aerospace successfully reached orbit and deployed payloads on its second flight, marking a historic first for private European spaceflight.

title.zh: Zcash创八年新高逼近850美元，Grayscale推ETF助推
title.en: Zcash Surges to Eight-Year High Near $850 on Grayscale ETF Push

current_state.zh: Zcash价格突破1000美元（盘中高点1050.70美元），Grayscale ZCSH ETF资产达4.147亿美元，期货未平仓量首次突破20亿美元
current_state.en: Zcash trades above $1,000 (intraday high $1,050.70), Grayscale ZCSH ETF assets reach $414.7 million, futures open interest surpasses $2 billion for the first time

title.zh: Coinbase Files SEC Notices to Bring Single-Stock Perpetuals to U.S. - Coin Edition
title.en: Coinbase Files SEC Notices to Bring Single-Stock Perpetuals to U.S. - Coin Edition

current_state.zh: Coinbase 已正式面向美国客户推出 24/7 股票永续合约，此前已提交 SEC 通知并面临 CME 诉讼，但实际推出已实现。
current_state.en: Coinbase has launched 24/7 stock perpetuals for US customers, following its SEC filings and pending CME lawsuit, with the product now live.

title.zh: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
title.en: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf

current_state.zh: SoFi与Kraken宣布合作，由Kraken母公司Payward上市SoFiUSD，接入24/7结算网络，并通过Kraken Prime提供数字资产流动性，体现银行与加密服务融合。
current_state.en: SoFi and Kraken announce a partnership where Kraken parent Payward lists SoFiUSD, connects to SoFi's 24/7 settlement network, and provides digital asset liquidity via Kraken Prime, signaling convergence between banking and crypto services.
